title: Pixel Party
summary: A four-person build of a real-time drawing-and-guessing game. Players draw on a shared canvas while the lobby guesses in chat — every stroke, guess and timer tick travels over WebSockets and lands in MongoDB.
body: Four-person project built to show React, Express and MongoDB working under real-time load. Login and registration were the first sprint; the game itself runs on WebSockets, with the server driving each round on a timer so players can join mid-game.

title: Raspberry Pi Die Counter
summary: A three-person hardware project: point a Raspberry Pi camera at a tray of dice, isolate each die, and return the sum. Includes a 3D-printed enclosure designed and printed on campus.
body: The goal was a physical input device driven by Python. We chose a camera and dice because the output is immediately verifiable. The hard part was isolation — early builds missed dice under uneven light, which we fixed by tuning the thresholding pipeline.
